question: What elevated central feature is distinguished on this mountain of sixty-eight parts?
premises: The mountain is associated with sixty-eight.
A middle location on this mountain is indicated.
An elevated mountain or peak is named.
inference: An elevated peak stands in the middle of this mountain associated with sixty-eight.
uncertainties: The exact referent of aṣṭaṣaṣṭiḥ (peaks, divisions, or units) is unclear.
plain_english: On this mountain, indeed sixty-eight, there is an elevated mountain in the middle.
